question: Did Barcelona first become capital of the Principality of Catalonia after joining Aragon, or did that role continue?

draft.raw: O1|P2.2|Subject: Barcelona|Date: 2026-09-29T14:46:17Z|Barcelona became the capital of the Principality of Catalonia after joining with the Kingdom of Aragon to form the composite monarchy of the Crown of Aragon.

claims.subject: Subject: Barcelona
claims.text: Barcelona became the capital of the Principality of Catalonia after joining with the Kingdom of Aragon to form the composite monarchy of the Crown of Aragon.

references.label: P2.2
references.text: After joining with the Kingdom of Aragon to form the composite monarchy of the Crown of Aragon, Barcelona, which continued to be the capital of the Principality of Catalonia, became the most important city in the Crown of Aragon and its main economic and administrative centre, only to be overtaken by Valencia, wrested from Moorish control by the Catalans, shortly before the dynastic union between the Crown of Castile and the Crown of Aragon in 1516.

rendered: Barcelona became the capital of the Principality of Catalonia after joining with the Kingdom of Aragon to form the composite monarchy of the Crown of Aragon. [1]
